blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for condos and townhomes in North Meadows. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. The reports count condos and townhomes together in one line, so this table cannot separate the two. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Pitt Meadows total for condos and townhomes that month.

blocks.text: Listings of condos and townhomes in North Meadows rose from 7 in June to 9 in September, and 4 sold across the 4 months. In September the community held 13.6% of Pitt Meadows’s 66 condos and townhomes listed.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes are for sale in North Meadows?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 9 condos and townhomes listed in North Meadows. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is North Meadows a buyers’ or sellers’ market for condos and townhomes?
faq.a: In September 2026, condos and townhomes in North Meadows had a sales ratio of 22% on only 9 listed, too few to read as a market type. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes sold in North Meadows from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 4 condos and townhomes sold in North Meadows over those 4 months, out of 56 in all of Pitt Meadows.

faq.q: Do these numbers separate condos from townhomes?
faq.a: No. The monthly reports publish condos and townhomes as one line, so every count here includes both. Jared can pull the split for a specific building or street.
